snippet.title: Roguelike mindfulness deckbuilder: Pearls of Wisdom - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Announcing our newest game Pearls of Wisdom, a rogue-like mindfulness deckbuilding game. Match words and themes from inspiring quotes, combine emblems with special effects, and do real world side quests to get a higher score. Due for release Spring 2026. #indiegame #games #gaming  #videogames #roguelike
